Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		usr: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.UserID = uid),
		bookCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(bc|bc.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		usr.size() = 1 and
		bookCopy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		bookCopy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE and
		bookCopy.IsReserved = false and
		User.allInstance()->includes(usr)
	postcondition:
		let newLoan: Loan in
		newLoan.oclIsNew() and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(book) and
		newLoan.LoanedUser = usr and
		newLoan.LoanedCopy = bookCopy and
		bookCopy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		result = true
}
